items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. The only TLS evidence is that no certificate is reported expiring within 30 days; this is not proof of complete TLS safety. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked; preserve private and parked launch gates; allow only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, or rights-dependent exposure. Continue existing read-only evidence work without accessing credentials or private containers, changing permissions/configuration, deploying, exploiting targets, or conducting outreach.

Security retains the candidate plan's containment-only direction and rejects new security-sensitive implementation, deployment, requeue, dependency, telemetry, credential, permission, or outreach work this cycle. Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix and private launch gate. Reconsider only after dated evidence covers access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness.
